text:
maya: Heads-up — for the SLOs page we're surfacing per-tenant threshold + notify routing settings. Quick Q: should quiet-window defaults live per-tenant or be inherited from tenant group?

 tom: i'd prefer inheritance for defaults, then per-tenant overrides. fewer clicks for small customers. :+1:

 sree: inheritance makes sense but needs a clear UI hint. otherwise support will get alerts like "why did my notify change".

 maya: agreed. UX idea: when the tenant isn't overridden show "inherited from group X" inline and a small "edit overrides" link.

 tom: API-wise we can keep fields: "thresholds": {...}, "notify_policy": {"source":"inherited"|"overridden","override_id":...}

 sree: +1. Also we should add a sampling knob for noisy signals. propose a per-rule sampling rate and a global sampling cap per-tenant. e.g.

 ```
 notify_rule: {
   threshold: 0.98,
   sampling_rate: 0.2  // 20% of matches
 }
 tenant_config: { max_notify_per_minute: 5 }
 ```

 maya: that helps. question: will sampling affect error budgets / SLI counts? we need to be explicit.

 tom: sampling should only affect notifications, not SLI computations. otherwise SLO math breaks. add field "notify_only_sampling".

 sree: and we should surface that in the console: a tiny "notifications sampled" badge with tooltip that links to docs.

 deploy-bot: rollout checklist for SLO UI changes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-ui-rollout

 maya: last thing — during the canary, let's route high-priority customers to full notify (no sampling) by default. canary list maintained in the routing policy.

 tom: implemented a draft: `notifyRoutingOverrides` keyed by tenant id. will PR today.

 sree: i'll add telemetry metrics: notify_attempts, notify_sent, notify_sampled, notify_blocked_by_quota. makes rollouts measurable.

 maya: perfect. follow-ups: 1) API schema review 2) small UX mock for inherited state 3) telemetry dashboard query. assigning tasks in jira.
